text:
The fastest land animal in the world is the cheetah.

Based on your travel history and preferences, I recommend visiting Tanzania, specifically combining a safari in the Serengeti National Park with a stay in Zanzibar. The Serengeti offers abundant wildlife and is an excellent location for bird watching, which would appeal to your partner. Afterward, you can relax on the pristine white-sand beaches of Zanzibar, satisfying your desire for beach relaxation. This itinerary builds on your positive experience in Kenya while offering a diverse mix of adventure and leisure.
